validation_status_contract.verification_scope_meaning: Intended checking scope only, never a passed result
default_bound_pass_requires: Current raw-state and signed-flux audit actually passed at frozen tolerances
Applicable named numerical gates actually executed and passed with explicit coverage
Same actual source snapshot, contract version and complete expanded input content verified and bound to evidence
No missing, skipped, failed, mismatched or schema-example evidence is treated as a pass
validation_status_contract.custom_execution_failures_and_unrun_chec: Preserve actual execution_status and per-check results independently; the custom label cannot hide failures or grant screening

sequence: read-only independent audit and bounded reproduction packaging
evidence_binding_proposal.demo_without_verification: Diagnostic output only; frozen defaults stay not_run and cannot receive formal sampled screening
evidence_binding_proposal.input_identity_encoding: UTF-8 of json.dumps(full_strict_input, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) plus LF; SHA256 of persisted bytes, recomputed by consumer; no omitted fields or numeric coercion
evidence_binding_proposal.coverage_mapping: Only existing criteria and named reference/convergence domains; representative coverage must not be called a per-case solve; current demo supplies its own per-case audit/diagnostic evidence
evidence_binding_proposal.file_reference_path_rule: Controlled module-relative regular-file paths; no absolute path, traversal or symlink; reproduction preserves module-relative layout
evidence_binding_proposal.unbound_policy: No promotion: missing/incomplete/mismatch defaults remain not_run; actual applicable numerical or audit failure remains failed; W screening unresolved or unknown_numerical

scenario_manifest.expansion_rule: Copy defaults into each full scenario JSON; substitute named program and bundle, then the explicit run Gamma/length/boundary/rho and non-null K_ref_override/Bi_ref_override. Store expanded inputs before integration. Arbitrary user patches are not accepted.
scenario_manifest.interpretation: Discrete synthetic assumption envelope, not measured covariance, probability confidence interval, continuous feasible region or supplier ranking

fixed_numerical_gates.tolerance_source: B2-1.0.1 contract constants in reviewed code and independently encoded reviewer; never output-artifact configuration

A-SEALED.oracle: Independent H integral and independently derived uniform sealed ODE solution; contract section 8.2

A-DIFF.oracle: Independent diffusion-time transform and cell-averaged half-slab series; contract section 8.2

resource_limits.host_constraint_provided_by_task: 1 core / 6 GB; not independently measured by Planner
resource_limits.legacy_B1_low_issue: Custom short-budget timeout correctly returned partial/exit3 but failure telemetry retained global 180.0; B2 must separate active budget and ceiling without modifying B1

screening_policy.condition_key_rule: First scenario_id in each uncertainty_pairs entry; nonpaired diagnostics use their own scenario_id

criteria.requirement: Manager must read back all three B2-1.0.1 artifacts, accept the synthetic scope and explicitly dispatch isolated implementation; this Planner card creates no follow-up cards and authorizes no production.
evidence_expected: Manager review record naming contract version and accepted assumptions
Future implementation card referencing the immutable contract and audited B1 baseline
criteria.verification_method: Manager reads exact files, cross-checks versions and the manifest, records approval separately from Planner completion. No implementation gate is inferred from task done alone.

criteria.requirement: Prescribed spatially uniform temperature, fixed geometry/porosity, C/O-only stoichiometry, shared approximate equimolar transport; no energy, pressure, pore closure, production times, quality or emissions claim.
criteria.verification_method: Cold read code and exports against contract sections 1-4. Reject fake not_modelled numerical zeros or claims of ideal-gas constant pressure closure.

criteria.requirement: Every executable relationship and parameter is marked synthetic_assumption or a conservation definition; S02/S09 candidates are not imported as intrinsic raw-sludge constants.
evidence_expected: Relation/source registry with material, atmosphere, temperature, units, basis and exclusions
criteria.verification_method: Check S02 temperature ceiling/A600 bundle cautions and S09 N2 preheat, O2/CO2, conversion window, noninteger oxygen order versus K0 units; compare candidate CSV with runtime input provenance and reject silent migration.

criteria.requirement: Use one fixed uncalibrated t_star, constant c_star and epsilon across compared cases; ell modifies d/ell^2 and Bi_ref/ell, not the temperature-program clock or K_ref. rho uses actual half-thickness volume.
evidence_expected: Coefficient unit tests for ell=1 and ell=2
Length-pair report with unchanged common tau
criteria.verification_method: Reviewer independently substitutes definitions into dimensional inventory equations, checks surface and reservoir coefficients, and rejects per-case time rescaling or implicit p/RT concentration normalization.

criteria.requirement: Screen only discrete conditional synthetic cases using load, reaction exposure/timing and transport/length together; actual raw-sludge mapping remains unknown. No supplier score or optimal recipe.
evidence_expected: Report discussing missing dry-basis and base-material mapping
criteria.verification_method: Recompute statuses using contract section 7.3, paired conditions, guard and both diagnostic thresholds; verify no continuous-window interpolation or claimed statistical confidence. All failures/near-threshold/mixed-bundle cases stay unresolved or unknown.

criteria.requirement: Report falsifiable counterexamples/sensitivity without guaranteeing the desired direction or requiring new long-term factory data as a research prerequisite.
evidence_expected: W timing/uncertainty and W/L length pairs
Explicit no-observed-reversal or unresolved statements when applicable
criteria.verification_method: Reviewer checks every directional sentence against actual paired outputs; distinguishes particle-size versus wall-thickness and wet-mass versus dry-carbon effects. Never invent a ranking reversal or measured material result.

criteria.requirement: R01-R04 must regress to audited B1 isothermal sentinels at the declared numerical tolerance and retain mean/local/null event semantics.
evidence_expected: Fresh B1 sentinel outputs in safe copy
Independent comparison log with parameters and error maxima
criteria.verification_method: Compare common N=15 and sampled tau; scaled state/inventory/flux error <=1e-4, event difference <=0.1 tau, null matches null. Do not rerun old full suites or edit the baseline.

criteria.requirement: All default cases conserve declared C/O/nominal mass with signed fluxes; C01 is unchanged, C02/C03 respect oxygen conversion upper bounds and no inventory is clipped.
evidence_expected: Raw state and flux intervals for all manifest scenarios
criteria.verification_method: Independent reconstruction using cell volumes and initial inventory scale at 1e-6; finite signed-transfer error <=1e-12; inspect true reservoir integration and positive-step logic, reject negative/nonfinite inventory or post-step clipping.

criteria.requirement: Temperature interpolation and nonautonomous integration must use correct stage times, temperature-dependent coefficients and knot-aligned steps, including holds and cooling.
criteria.verification_method: Independent T/K/d/g evaluation <=1e-12 normalized error; verify stages at tau and tau+dt, coefficient endpoint checks, step split at knots, theta=0/m=0 degeneracy and no temperature extrapolation.

criteria.requirement: Nonisothermal sealed uniform kinetics must match an independently constructed exposure-based reference for oxygen-rich, stoichiometric and oxygen-limited cases.
evidence_expected: Raw reference and solver trajectories for Gamma=0.25/1/2
criteria.verification_method: Independently derive the closed ODE solution; segment Simpson H integral until successive change <=1e-9 within 4096 subintervals, then compare u/v/f <=2e-5 absolute error. No solver/coefficient/diagnostics imports in the oracle.

criteria.requirement: Time-varying diffusion must match an independent diffusion-time transformed half-slab reference, separately named as a test-only Dirichlet fixture.
criteria.verification_method: Independent S_D piecewise-linear integration and 128/256-term cell-average series; series change <=1e-9; N31 max u error <=5e-4 for tau>=0.5; errors improve with grids. Do not claim this alone verifies Robin or full material transport.

criteria.requirement: W03/L02/C03 must pass separately controlled space and time refinement with fixed gates; nullable events must not be treated as zero error.
evidence_expected: Raw convergence trajectories and input variants
Metric differences and real step counts
Event brackets and nullable event comparisons
criteria.verification_method: Space grids 7/15/31 at dt_scale0.25 and time scales1/0.5/0.25 at N31; use fixed_numerical_gates for errors, improvement ratio and floor. One-null events are unresolved; both-null time_error is null and continuous metrics are still checked.

criteria.requirement: Average versus maximum-cell residual thresholds are separate; missing oxygen-induced stopping is not burnout; no numerical failure is classified as material infeasibility.
criteria.verification_method: Recompute first sampled threshold crossings and brackets from raw f; source-rate decay alone must not set completion. Validate all status dimensions and fixed not_modelled fields.

criteria.requirement: Default manifest identity and actual numerical coverage must be explicit; custom audit_only cases cannot inherit default convergence or screening approval. verification_scope is frozen_suite or audit_only, never a pass result; numerical_validation follows validation_status_contract.
evidence_expected: Input manifest hashes and expanded JSON
verification.json with named executed cases and domains
Default not_run before binding and conditional promotion only after matching source, complete inputs, current audit and real numerical coverage
Schema-example rejection and source/input/evidence mismatch controls
criteria.verification_method: Change a legal custom parameter while retaining the scenario name; verify content identity changes and numerical_validation is not_verified_for_custom_case with verification_scope=audit_only. No pass inheritance based only on scenario_id, artifacts or audit success. Check exact enums, default not_run, actual failure as failed, and evidence-bound-only passed_frozen_suite under contract section 7.2; final CLI/file binding proposal B2-BIND-001 is pending_manager_decision, not a new numerical gate or implementation authorization.

criteria.requirement: Export audit independently reconstructs inventories and signed integrated fluxes using fixed B2-AUDIT-1 tolerance, not artifact residual/pass/tolerance fields.
evidence_expected: Positive control without prewritten audit/verification files
Reconstruction results and fixed tolerance origin
criteria.verification_method: Remove self-reported diagnostic files and reconstruct from inputs/raw trajectories/flux intervals; ensure 1e-6 tolerance is encoded independently and cannot be widened by summary/config/nested artifacts.

criteria.requirement: Defined export mutations must be rejected, while claims explicitly exclude guaranteed detection of arbitrary coordinated rewriting or full ODE authenticity.
evidence_expected: Mutation fixture scripts, mutated-copy identifiers, exit codes and safe errors
criteria.verification_method: Mutate inventory, reservoir, flux sign, missing interval/profile, duplicate row, NaN/negative state, null event, local threshold, fake energy/pressure and nested tolerance-plus-inventory; expect rejection. Reviewer cold-reads the limits; hash consistency is not scientific authenticity.

criteria.requirement: Strict JSON input validation and domain preflight must reject malformed, ambiguous, nonfinite, oversized, unknown or unsupported scientific inputs before integration.
evidence_expected: Input rejection tests for each input_domain rule
Fixed error-code logs without raw payload reflection
Zero integration calls for rejected inputs
criteria.verification_method: Test duplicate/missing/unknown keys, bool-as-number, numeric strings, NaN/Inf, Celsius-labelled temperature, knot duplicate/out-of-range/missing endpoint, illegal finite/sealed parameters, oversized/nested input and executable expressions. Exit2 and no overwritten output.

criteria.requirement: Only controlled local regular files inside the new module are accepted/written; existing outputs, path traversal and symlink escape fail closed without data deletion or overwrites.
evidence_expected: Input/output path and symlink escape fixtures
criteria.verification_method: Resolve authorized paths, reject symlink components/absolute external paths/.. escape/nonregular input and existing targets. Keep all test fixtures in reviewer-owned temporary area. Document no guarantee for hostile concurrent multiuser filesystem service.

criteria.requirement: Frozen runs remain serial and within finite wall-time, RSS, grid/step/invocation and archive budgets without new dependencies or paid resources.
evidence_expected: Internal and externally observed wall/RSS logs
criteria.verification_method: Measure the real default demo, focused references/convergence and independent review against resource_limits. Timeout/resource limits are partial/exit3, never success or material exclusion. Exhausted budget stops work; no automatic full rerun or grid expansion.

criteria.requirement: B2 CLI must separate active budget from ceiling on success, timeout and other failure paths; preserve the B1 LOW issue as history without editing B1.
evidence_expected: Invalid input and forced numerical failure telemetry
criteria.verification_method: Verify timeout returns partial_timeout/exit3 and records active_budget_seconds=0.000001, ceiling_budget_seconds=180, actual phase/completed/pending. All paths use their actual active value, not legacy global180 telemetry.

criteria.requirement: Export required CSV/JSON/Markdown/SVG artifacts with explicit units, null/status semantics, all inputs, assumptions, numerical domain and actual runtime provenance.
criteria.verification_method: Check headers/schema and required fields; reconstruct metrics and graph coordinates from raw CSV at declared rounding tolerance. SVG must have no scripts, event attributes, foreignObject, external links/resources. Do not claim pixel/CJK validation without rendering evidence.

criteria.requirement: All reproduction-critical source, test, reviewer scripts, input manifest, expanded inputs, raw results, commands and environment instructions must persist; scratch paths alone do not close the handoff.
evidence_expected: B2 reproduction archive and actual computed SHA256
criteria.verification_method: Inspect archive for traversal/absolute paths/links/special files, safely replay in new isolated copy using only persistent material, compare deterministic outputs and allow timestamps/resources to vary. Distinguish raw byte hashes from normalized CSV LF comparisons. Required support files must be in commit/archive, not ephemeral cache.

criteria.requirement: No credentials, paid API/provider switch, OCI change, production/network service control, public message/release/deploy/delete or training/financial/industrial action; modifications confined to new B2 module.
criteria.verification_method: Review changed files only without opening real secret stores; verify offline stdlib-only imports and no external side-effect code. Check unchanged B1/Stage1/core baseline. Any new high-risk scope requires separate human approval; current task grants none.

criteria.requirement: Independent Safety approval is mandatory after implementation; Engineer self-tests or B1 approval cannot approve B2. Manager owns next research/release decisions.
evidence_expected: Separate Safety reviewer provenance and real command outputs
Machine verdict with approved, approval_scope, production_approved=false and required_changes
All applicable blocking criterion results linked to evidence
criteria.verification_method: Safety independently cold-reads and replays named numerical, audit, input/path, budget and scientific gates from preserved artifacts. Missing independent evidence means pending/not_run, never PASS. Manager reviews before any subsequent expansion.
